name: Titans Most Wanted
summary:
Are you ready to have some fun with Robin, Raven, Starfire, Cyborg and Beast Boy in the Titans Most Wanted game? The team needs your help more than ever, now that the most atrocious villains have flooded Jump City in order to attend the Crime Convention.

What is more, Robin came up with a great idea: Bad Guy Bingo! Can you beat Batman's record and bring down 14 villains in just one day? It sure sounds like an exciting challenge, so get ready to prove your strategy skills while enjoying the lively atmosphere and upbeat music, in this tactical RPG battle!
